Late sleepers are more likely to experience irregular sleep cycles, reduced sleep quality, and health issues such as metabolic disorders, which can contribute to long term risks. Social schedules that favor early routines may also create chronic sleep debt. Experts emphasize that consistent sleep patterns and adequate rest are key factors in maintaining long term health, making sleep timing an important part of overall wellness. Source: Chronobiology International
